senses.gloss:
mfn. (-क्कुः-क्कुः-क्कु)
Idle, lazy, following no business or profession.

n. (-क्थं)
Bee's wax; also शिक्थकं and सिक्थकं.

m. (-क्थः)
1 A handful or mouthful of boiled rice.
2 Boiled rice.
n. (-क्थं)
1 Bee's wax.
2 Indigo.
E.
षिच् to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. थक्.

nf. (-क्यं-क्या)
1 The string or loop suspended from either end of a pole or yoke to receive the burthen.
2 The burthen so carried.
3 The strings of a balance.
E.
श्रंस to fall, Uṇādi aff. यत्; शि substituted for the root, and कुट् augment.

m. (-रः)
The hook or eye at each end of a pole or beam, to which the strings of a yoke or balance are fastened.
E.
शिक्या as above, and आधार receptacle.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Suspended or carried in a sort of loop.
E.
शिक्य a loop, and इतच् aff.

r. 1st cl. (शिक्षते)
To learn, to acquire science.

f. (-क्षा)
1 One of the six Vedāṅgas or sciences attached to the Vedas: the proper pronunciation of the vocal sounds which occur in them, as explained by PĀṆINI.
2 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
3 Learning, study, the acquisition of knowledge.
4 Modesty, humility.
E.
शिक्ष to learn, affs. अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A learner, a teacher.
E.
शिक्ष to learn, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be taught or learnt.
E.
शिक्ष to learn, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 VYĀSA.
2 An instructor.
E.
शिक्षा the science of pronunciation, and कर making.

f. (-क्तिः)
Dexterity, skill.
E.
शिक्षा discipline, and शक्ति power.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Skilful, clever, conversant.
2 Modest, diffident.
3 Disciplined, exercised.
4 Tame, trained, (as an animal.)
5 Docile.
6 Studied, learned.
E.
शिक्षा studying, इतच् aff. or शिक्ष to study, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be taught or learnt.
E.
शिक्ष to learn, and तव्य aff.

m. (-रः)
A pupil, a scholar.
E.
शिक्षित studied, (by whom,) and अक्षर a letter.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
1 To be taught, teachable.
E.
शिक्ष to learn, यत् aff.

m. (-क्ष्यं)
Crystal, glass.

r. 1st cl. (ऋ) शीकृ (शेकते)
To wet or moisten, to sprinkle.
r. 10th cl. (शेकयति)
1 To endure patiently, to be patient.
2 To touch.
3 To wet, to moisten.

r. 1st and 10th cls.
1 To touch.
2 To bear.
(ऋ) सीकृ r. 1st cl. (सीकति)
To sprinkle, to shed or shower.

m. (-रः)
1 Thin rain, or rain driven by wind.
2 A drop of water.
n. (-रं)
A sort of pine or its resin.
E.
शीक to sprinkle, aff. अरन्.

m. (-रः)
Thin drizzling rain.
E.
सीक to scatter, (as water,) अरन् aff.; also शीकर.

mfn. (-घः-घा-घं)
Abounding with mist, spray or thin rain.
E.
शीकर, and ओघ a heap.

f. (-ता)
1 Sandy soil.
2 Gravel or stone, (the disease.)
m. plu. (-ताः)
Sand.
E.
सिकि Sautra root, to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. अतच्.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Sandy.
n. (-यं)
A sand bank, or an island with sandy shores.
E.
सिकप्ता sand, मयट् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Sandy, (in general.)
E.
सिकत sand, मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Sandy, as a soil or country.
E.
सिकता sand, aff. इलच्.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Sprinkled, wetted.
E.
षिच to sprinkle, क्त aff.

ind.
Having sprinkled, effused, &c.
E.
षिच to sprinkle, क्त्वा aff.

n. (-कं)
Bee's wax.
E.
कन् added to the last.
